# Concurrency

Three tools, three jobs:

| Tool | Job |
|------|-----|
| `threading` | Overlap **waiting** (I/O) in one process |
| `multiprocessing` | Overlap **CPU** in several processes |
| `asyncio` | Many I/O waits on one thread (event loop) |

The **GIL** (Internals) explains why CPU-bound threads do not scale on the default build. Free-threaded 3.14 is a fourth option you measure, not a default.

## Planned chapters

| Chapter | Focus |
|---------|--------|
| Threads and `Lock` | Shared memory, invariants |
| Processes and queues | Isolation, pickle boundaries |
| `concurrent.futures` | The usual facade |
| asyncio primer | `async def`, `await`, tasks |
| When to pick which | A decision table |

Ramalho’s concurrency parts and *High Performance Python* are the deep books. This section is the language view (threads, processes, `asyncio`).
